_comment: The clause library: sentences ready in English, Marathi and Hindi, with gaps ({name}) for a template's facts. Gaps hold only dates, times, numbers and names, never nouns: where the noun changes (camp, championship, trial), there is one clause per variant, since Marathi and Hindi inflect it. Text taken from an existing printed registration form is word for word; `_review` lists the languages written for the library that need a fluent reader.

day_parts._comment: a time prints with the part of the day it falls in: before 12, before 16, before 20, after
